label: Dragon's Dogma: Dark Arisen sandboxes
description: How Dragon's Dogma: Dark Arisen sandboxes deploy, and how to find the game on this machine. Paths: mo2.

notes: Mods replace files of the same name under nativePC, so two mods touching one .arc are a conflict and the later one wins. Keep the original files backed up - the sandbox's backup store does this for deployed mods.
Many mods need the ModLoader/DDDA Mod Manager tooling that is installed separately; this app only places the files.
Hard links are the default: nothing is copied twice when two sandboxes share a mod, and every file is still a real file to the game.

presets.label: Clean
presets.description: Nothing deployed - the vanilla game, for checking whether a bug is yours.

options.label: Additional launch arguments
options.description: Passed verbatim. One argument per space; nothing here goes through a shell.
